item.title: Axera Debuts 5nm M9 ADAS SoC Series With Up to About 720 TOPS
item.description: Axera launched its 5nm M9 ADAS SoC series — flagship M97 at about 720 TOPS and mainstream M95 at about 360 TOPS — with self-developed NPU, ISP and CVA blocks and dual-chip redundancy near 1,440 TOPS.

item.title: Tsinghua AIR Zeva Lifts Embodied Manipulation Success From 26% to 73% Without Retraining
item.description: Tsinghua AIR, with Domain Transform, introduced Zeva — frozen-weight in-context causal memory that raised cumulative embodied manipulation success from about 26% to 73% on Cosmos3-backed ChemLab-Evo tasks.

item.title: Tsingway and BAAI Open-Source Open3D-PIMC for 3D Compute Chips Under FlagOS
item.description: At the China Computing Power Conference, Tsingway and the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence open-sourced Open3D-PIMC, a programming model and framework for 3D compute chips inside the FlagOS stack.

item.title: Unitree Unveils G1+ Humanoid With Six Upgrades, Priced Near RMB 95,000
item.description: Unitree refreshed its G1 humanoid as G1+, adding neck degrees of freedom, stronger cooler motors, dual vision plus tactile and six-mic audio, and an external power port, with the standard model listed around RMB 95,000 tax-included.

item.title: Unisound Launches U2-Flash MoE as Post-Training RSI Flagship Flash Model
item.description: Unisound unveiled U2-Flash, a ~266B sparse MoE with ~10B active parameters, pairing post-training recursive self-improvement and latent reasoning for agent and coding workloads, now live on its MaaS platform.
